files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added
- Sessions: filters under the column headers (year, sport, spot, rating, equipment), combined with sorting; "Clear filters" and the number of sessions shown.
- Spots: the number of sessions of each spot (list) and a "Show the sessions" button (map bubble) open the sessions filtered on this spot.
- Quiver: the number of sessions of each piece of equipment opens the sessions filtered on it.
- Sharing (Share button of a session, a spot, a piece of equipment, the map of all spots, the statistics or one statistics section):
  - message: text ready to send by SMS, e-mail or messaging app (system share sheet, or copy), ending with a link to the project;
  - public link: read-only web page for someone without Nextcloud (photo, map, GPS track, conditions), valid 24 hours (default) or 7 days, never without expiry, optional hiding of the exact spot position, revocable; built on Nextcloud's public share controller (unknown tokens are throttled, links disabled when the administrator disables public links);
  - send to a user of the same Nextcloud: copy of a spot (position, description, photos), of a piece of equipment (characteristics, photos) or of a session (date, times, spot, conditions, sender added as a buddy), with a Nextcloud notification; the recipient adds it to their logbook or declines it.
- "Sharing" page: items received and active public links (copy, open, revoke).
